title: Optional --check-urls flag HEAD-requests each citation and downgrades citation_quality on 4xx or 5xx
question: Does open-outcome verify accept an opt-in --check-urls flag that downgrades citation_quality by one with floor 1 when any citation URL returns 4xx or 5xx while keeping the default path deterministic with no network access?
success_criteria: sdk-python open_outcome cli py exposes a --check-urls flag on the verify subcommand off by default
when --check-urls is set the CLI HEAD-requests each citation URL using urllib and downgrades citation_quality by one with floor 1 if any URL returns HTTP 400 or higher
transport errors DNS timeout connection refused are explicitly ignored so a flaky network does not silently break the gate
two new pytest tests cover both the downgrade-on-4xx path and the off-by-default invariant that head_check is not called without the flag
specification appendix-a-rubric md documents the optional flag under the citation_quality dimension

capabilities: sdk-python cli py adds --check-urls verify subcommand argument
url liveness downgrade applies post-verdict to keep HeuristicVerifier pure
transport errors ignored to avoid flaky-network false fails
two new tests pass plus the existing 27 tests
appendix-a-rubric md documents the optional flag
